claims.quote: Ompok fumidus has a wide distribution over the Malay Peninsula, Sumatra, Borneo, Riau Islands and Thailand.
Type locality: North Selangor peat swamp forest, 43 km on road from Tanjong Malim to Sungai Besar, Selangor, Malaysia.

regions.name: Batang Hari
regions.quote: The IUCN Red List: this species occurs from the Mae Nam Kolok drainage southwards to the Pahang River drainage in the Malay Peninsula; Pulau Bintan (Riau Archipelago); Batang Hari drainage in central Sumatra, and the Kapuas River drainage southwards to the Arut River drainage in Borneo, with an estimated extent of occurrence (EOO) of 573,960 km2.
